**BLUF:** Below is the 5‑day Instagram plan for your tee shop launch, including a quick reminder of eBay’s UK fees for clothing.

---

### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan

| Day | Theme | Post Concept | Caption Hook |
|-----|-------|--------------|--------------|
| **Day 1** | Teaser / Brand reveal | Black background with the Faded Archive logo slowly coming into focus | “Something fresh is coming… #FadedArchive” |
| **Day 2** | Behind‑the‑scenes | Time‑lapse of a tee being printed from design to finished shirt | “From canvas to closet – watch the art unfold. #PrintJourney” |
| **Day 3** | Product spotlight | A cozy, close‑up shot of the first tee in natural light, showing texture | “Real fabric, real vibes. Which color do you want first? #TeeTalk” |
| **Day 4** | Customer‑generated content idea | Invite followers to share a photo of them wearing a tee for a giveaway | “Show us how you style #FadedArchive and win a free tee!” |
| **Day 5** | Launch day call‑to‑action | Bold graphic announcing shop launch with link (if available) | “We’re live! Grab your first tee before they’re gone. #NewShop” |

- **Consistent style:** Use a muted, vintage filter; keep the logo subtle but visible.  
- **CAPTION length:** Aim for 50–70 words; include a single CTA per post.  
- **Hashtags:** Mix 3–5 core brand tags (#FadedArchive, #PrintOnDemand) with 2–3 trend tags (#OOTD, #Streetwear).

---

### Quick eBay Fees Reminder (UK)

| Fee Type | Rough % / Amount (UK) |
|----------|-----------------------|
| **Final Value Fee** (clothing) | 13 % of the sale price (up to £35); 12 % above £35 |
| **PayPal Seller Fee** | 2.9 % + £0.30 per transaction |
| **Optional:** 3‑Day Decline Protection | £6.95 per listing (if you opt‑in) |

**Tip:** If you use eBay’s Store subscription, you get a lower base fee (e.g., 6 % instead of 13 %) and a monthly subscription cost. Adjust your pricing accordingly.
